title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Matthew 10: the twelve apostles named and sent out, with instructions, warnings and promises for the road.

questions.text: What did Jesus give his twelve disciples when he called them to himself?
questions.explanation: He gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

answers.text: Gold and silver for the journey
Authority over unclean spirits and to heal
Two coats and a staff each
A place in the Kingdom of Heaven

questions.text: Who is named first in the list of the twelve apostles?
questions.explanation: The list begins with the first, Simon, who is called Peter, then Andrew his brother.

questions.text: How is Matthew described in the list of the twelve?
questions.explanation: The list names Matthew the tax collector among the twelve apostles.

questions.text: To whom did Jesus send the twelve?
questions.explanation: He told them not to go among the Gentiles or into a city of the Samaritans, but to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

answers.text: All the nations of the world
The lost sheep of the house of Israel

questions.text: What were they not to take in their money belts?
questions.explanation: Jesus told them not to take any gold, silver or brass in their money belts.

questions.text: What were they to do when a house or city would not receive them?
questions.explanation: Whoever does not receive them or hear their words, they are to shake the dust off their feet as they leave that house or city.

answers.text: Shake the dust off their feet
Call down fire on the city
Send word to the other apostles

questions.text: How did Jesus tell them to be, sent out as sheep among wolves?
questions.explanation: He sent them out as sheep among wolves and told them to be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.

answers.text: Strong as lions and bold as eagles
Silent as sheep before the shearer
Wise as serpents and harmless as doves
Gentle as doves and fierce as wolves

questions.text: Who will speak in them when they are delivered up?
questions.explanation: Jesus said it is not they who speak, but the Spirit of their Father who speaks in them.

questions.text: What does Jesus say about the hairs of their head?
questions.explanation: He says the very hairs of their head are all numbered, so they should not be afraid.

answers.text: They are counted by the angels

questions.text: What is promised to whoever gives one of these little ones a cup of cold water?
questions.explanation: Whoever gives one of these little ones a cup of cold water in the name of a disciple will in no way lose his reward.

answers.text: He will be called a prophet
He will not lose his reward
He will be least in the Kingdom
